newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on strong cash, commercials.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on strong cash, commercials.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed sharply higher on Monday, boosted by commercial buying amid strong cash prices, traders said.
"The market was deeply oversold and way below the cash values," a floor source said. "This was mostly a correction."
Floor sources said recent declines from the $12 per cwt levels had attracted commercial buying interest. As futures prices fell below cash values, commercials found bargains, they said.
New crop contracts drew strength from continued heavy rains in the South that threatened to further delay plantings.
"We had six inches of rain in Arkansas and the market really doesn't have much of a weather premium yet," one floor source said.
Forecasts called for more rain later this week.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 400 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 1,673 lots.
Rice closed 22-1/2 to two cents per bushel higher with May up 22-1/2 at $11.32.
